question: Brihadisvara Temple, which has Chola Architecture and was built by Emperor Rajaraja is located in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Brihadisvara Temple, which has Chola Architecture and was built by Emperor Rajaraja, is located in Tamil Nadu.**
 
• **Thanjavur** (Tamil Nadu) is home to the **Shiva-dedicated Brihadeshwara Temple, also known as Raja Rajeswara Temple.**
